data.define: To study many things quickly just before a test.

misuse.why: Cramming only works for short tests.

data.l1_hook: Examen demain. Je n'ai pas étudié ! Il faut « cram ».

native.tip: “cram” = bûcher. Exemple: “I must cram for math.”
native.caption:
